_label_only: An optional field on a rule. The ruled turn is one or two tokens, so lib_locate cannot find it (MIN_TOKENS is 3), and every anchor long enough to locate it spans a neighbour belonging to a DIFFERENT speaker, which force_labels would relabel. `text` then carries the ANCHOR and `label_only` the exact body to relabel inside it. The tail's first word is at 1:51:02 in the caption track and Haziq lowers his microphone at 1:51:03, so the camera attests that Haziq stops. The questioner is off frame, so the camera cannot name them positively; the following block at 1:51:07 is already Audience. Anchor must carry `YB Rafizi Ramli serta` because the bare greeting appears three times in raw.md. Anchor deliberately stops before the questioner's own words, so a name correction cannot break it. fix_proper_nouns.py now rewrites `Haziq Asfar` to `Haziq Azfar` in this very block, and mai_camera_raw.py runs at adoption step 1 while that map runs at step 7, so the anchor would have matched today and failed on the next rebuild. CAMERA EVIDENCE 2026-09-17, not an owner ruling. ep00 is the pilot, shot wide from the back of the hall, so a face is about 20 pixels tall and YuNet almost never fires. That is why the reference reports `no face 2960s` and gives Haziq 51s against 8.7% of raw's words, and why the episode was adopted under --force-blind-reference. Cropping the stage strip and upscaling it to 1400px makes the face, the glasses and the microphone readable, so the camera signal was there the whole time. The owner's 05:42 ruling is the identity anchor: Haziq is the man in the maroon polo with glasses on the left, Rafizi the patterned batik on the right. SUPERSEDE THIS with a real reference once the crop-and-upscale pre-pass exists.
